sample: 雨后余生 / After the Rain
scope: Ninth original local playable direction: four painted original ImageGen bitmaps rendered in a top-down Canvas2D survival scene. A finite 21 by 15 map connects continuous collision-aware movement, fixed supplies, water collection, resource-accounted camp construction, three-second boiling, radio repair/signal, weather/body effects and dawn completion. The local world advances only while running and saved progress restores paused. Manual completion remains playable through later local weather cycles; the ordinary demo auto-pauses upon dawn completion. The actual rule, controller, real-browser and final resource-delivery evidence passes within its recorded scope. No offline simulation, server world, endless/procedural map, combat, three-dimensional presentation, upstream game port or human emotional/commercial product acceptance is claimed.
